acquisition.label: Android screen recording — PROOVRA app (client-attested)
acquisition.statement: The PROOVRA Android app reports that it recorded this device screen continuously, using Android's screen-capture consent, in a server-issued capture session. The recording is preserved as ordered segments; PROOVRA independently recomputed the digest of every segment and established integrity when the session was completed.

limitations.text: The capture ran on the user's device. The PROOVRA server did not observe it: that PROOVRA's software produced these bytes, and when the capture happened relative to the session, are reported by the client and not independently proven.
A screen capture preserves what was shown on the Android device's screen. It does not establish that the displayed content is true, who authored it, or that any person or account shown is genuine.

PROOVRA does not prove which app produced what was on screen, or that the underlying app or server actually supplied the displayed data. Content displayed by a modified app, a mock-up or an overlay cannot be ruled out.

The integrity of the Android device and OS was not independently verified. A rooted, emulated or otherwise modified device cannot be ruled out; protected content (secure windows) may appear blank or be omitted.

A continuous screen capture is preserved as a sequence of segments. PROOVRA records the segment order and any interruptions it detected (a stop, an OS revocation, a device or orientation change); it does not guarantee that nothing occurred in a gap, and an interrupted session is recorded as such rather than as a complete one.

publicAcquisition.qualifier: PROOVRA records how and when material was received and preserved. It does not establish that the content is true, who authored it, the identity of people shown, or that events occurred as depicted. Legal admissibility and evidentiary weight require separate review.
